The '''''Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics''''' is a [[peer-review]]ed [[scientific journal]] covering [[computational mathematics|computational]] and [[applied mathematics]]. It was established in 1975 and is published biweekly by [[Elsevier]]. The [[editors-in-chief]] are Yalchin Efendiev ([[Texas A&M University]]), Taketomo Mitsui ([[Nagoya University]]), Michael Kwok-Po Ng ([[Hong Kong Baptist University]]) and Fatih Tank ([[Ankara University]]). According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2021 [[impact factor]] of 2.6.<ref name="WoS">{{cite book|title=Journal Page|title-link=Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics|publisher=[[Elsevier]]|year=2024|edition=Science|series=[[Web of Science]]|chapter=Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics}}</ref>
